scope: Selective backports; keep classic personal source and all existing integration.
personal_adaptations: Adapt synchronous per-message persistence feedback without importing the newer SIM/ICCID transaction framework.
Apply jitter and monotonic browser RTP clock to the existing media session.
Use Chinese messages for newly added runtime logs.
Wait for a complete TCP REGISTER in the reset fixture so the test deterministically exercises an established connection failure; assertions preserved.
Remove an unreachable return from an existing phone test helper; assertions preserved.
deferred: Full SIM/managed-device transaction and multi-IMSI framework; current personal source lacks prerequisite ownership/snapshot identity changes.
New automatic answering, WebDAV archiving, MBN and notification filtering.
VoCat AT Session, raw-SMS schema, USSD backend and notification scheduler use another architecture; no whole-stack replacement.
VoLTE native-UAC/adaptive jitter/media recovery chain needs EC20/EC25 real-call validation. Current inline RTP reader already joins on Close, so d5f64cf does not apply directly.
ICE interface pruning was removed upstream by d82752d; current personal version already retains VPN/cellular candidates.
